titre: Comment les Américains étaient couverts en 2025
sous_titre: Part de la population concernée, en pourcentage, année 2025

Assurance de l'employeur.texte: employment-based insurance was the most common, covering 53.5% of the population for some or all of the calendar year

Medicare.texte: followed by Medicare (20.1%), Medicaid (17.1%), direct-purchase coverage (10.5%)

Medicaid.texte: Medicaid (17.1%), direct-purchase coverage (10.5%), TRICARE (2.8%), and VA and CHAMPVA coverage (1.2%)

Achat direct.texte: direct-purchase coverage (10.5%), TRICARE (2.8%), and VA and CHAMPVA coverage (1.2%)

Sans assurance.texte: In 2025, 26.7 million people (7.9%) were uninsured for the entire year, not statistically different from 2024.
